sets.relationshipLabel: what it sends out into the dark
sets.explanation: A lighthouse throws its beam the way a star throws its twinkle — each sends its own light into the night.

sets.relationshipLabel: the night flier and the shell it came from
sets.explanation: A moth emerges from its cocoon the way an owl hatches from its egg.
An ember dies down to ash; an echo dies away to silence.

sets.relationshipLabel: what it quietly leaves behind by morning
sets.explanation: The night leaves dew on the grass the way sleep leaves a dream in your head.
